quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: The Hungarian word 'Ildikó' (Barbara's Hungarian name!) comes from the ancient Huns and means 'warrior woman' or 'fighter.' Saint Ildikó was a princess who married Attila the Hun in the 5th century, making it a name with over 1,500 years of history!

short_read.title: How Trees Talk to Each Other
short_read.teaser: Scientists have discovered that trees communicate through an underground network of fungi, sharing nutrients and warning each other of danger. It's like a 'wood wide web' right beneath our feet!

medium_read.title: The Secret Lives of Orcas in the Pacific Northwest
medium_read.teaser: The orcas swimming through the Strait of Juan de Fuca have complex family bonds and unique dialects that identify their pods. Learn about the resident and transient orcas that call your waters home.

long_read.title: The Gardens of Budapest: A Journey Through Hungarian Horticulture
long_read.teaser: From the historic botanical gardens to the modern parks along the Danube, Budapest's green spaces tell the story of Hungarian culture and resilience. Discover the beauty and history of gardens in your homeland.

port_angeles.title: Deer Rutting Season Begins
port_angeles.description: September marks the beginning of rutting season for the black-tailed deer around Port Angeles and the Olympic Peninsula. You might spot bucks with their antlers in full velvet, preparing for the autumn mating season. Early morning and dusk are the best times to watch for them near the edges of meadows.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute when active.
puzzle_1.correct_response: That's right, Barbara! Amazingly fast — like a tiny helicopter engine!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is around 1,200 beats per minute — incredibly fast!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: These tiny birds are remarkable! A hummingbird's heart beats about 1,200 times per minute when flying — that's 20 beats every second!
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: Hummingbirds have the highest metabolism of all animals, which is why they need to eat almost constantly and visit hundreds of flowers each day to fuel their tiny bodies.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful, Ildikó! Pillangó is such a beautiful word for such a beautiful creature!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The answer is 'pillangó'! Such a lovely word. (Madár means bird, virág means flower, and méhecske means little bee.)
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: The Hungarian word 'pillangó' comes from an older form meaning 'fluttering one.' Hungary is home to over 200 species of butterflies, including the beautiful Scarce Swallowtail.

puzzle_3.question: What is the Olympic National Park's most famous temperate rainforest valley?
puzzle_3.correct_response: Yes! The Hoh Rain Forest is absolutely magical, with its moss-draped trees and lush green beauty. It receives over 12 feet of rain each year!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's the Hoh Rain Forest! This enchanted valley gets over 140 inches of rain yearly, creating one of the most lush temperate rainforests in the world, right in your backyard.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: The Hoh Rain Forest is home to some of the largest Sitka spruce, western red cedar, and Douglas fir trees in the world. The Hall of Mosses trail is one of the most stunning short walks in all of Olympic National Park.
